blocks.text: Amides mein functional group –CO–NH₂ hota hai. Yeh carboxylic acids se banaye jate hain, isi liye amides ko ab bhi kabhi kabhi “acid amides” kaha jata hai.
Amides in tareeqon se banaye ja sakte hain:
1. Acyl chlorides ka ammonia se reaction

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + NH3 se CH3-C(=O)-NH2 + HCl. Neeche: benzoyl chloride (ring-C(=O)-Cl) + NH3 se benzamide (ring-C(=O)-NH2) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur ammonia se amides (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: 2. Acyl chlorides ka primary amines se reaction

blocks.alt: CH3-C(=O)-Cl (ethanoyl chloride) + CH3-CH2-NH2 se CH3-C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH3 (N-ethyl ethanamide) + HCl. Neeche: CH3-C(=O)-Cl + phenyl amine se CH3-C(=O)-NH-ring (N-phenyl ethanamide) + HCl.
blocks.caption: Acyl chlorides aur primary amines se amides (kitab ke page 127 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: In dono tareeqon mein sab reactions room temperature par hote hain aur hydrogen chloride (HCl) ke white fumes (safaid dhuan) nikalte hain. Banne wala HCl ammonia ya amine ke aik aur molecule se react kar ke salt bana leta hai.

Methanamide liquid hai; is ke ilawa sab amides solid hain aur in ka melting point sharp (bilkul tay) hota hai. Molecules ke beech strong (mazboot) hydrogen bonding ki wajah se in ke boiling points kaafi oonche hain. N-substituted amides mein jitne zyada alkyl groups lagte hain, hydrogen bonding ki jagahen (N–H) utni kam hoti hain, is liye melting aur boiling points kam ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: R-NH2 + HCl se R-NH3(+) Cl(-). Neeche: NH3 + HCl se NH4(+) Cl(-).
blocks.caption: Amine aur ammonia ka HCl se salt banana (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is liye reaction poora karne ke liye ammonia ya amine excess (zyada) mein li jati hai.
